notes: ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome only, one dedicated tab; about 120 same-origin fetch() calls issued from the loaded noon.com page context, paced roughly 1 per second. Every request returned HTTP 200 - no 403, CAPTCHA, challenge or rate-limit at any point. ROBOTS: https://www.noon.com/robots.txt read fresh in the tab. 'User-agent: ClaudeBot' has its own group with 'Allow: /' (as do GPTBot, ChatGPT-User and PerplexityBot); the generic 'User-agent: *' group disallows only /_svc/ and /_vs/. The Claude-specific group is explicit permission, so extraction proceeded. TREE: /uae-en/furniture/ is a curated store landing page with no counts; the real department is /uae-en/home-and-kitchen/furniture-10180/. Its rendered left-hand Category filter carries the WHOLE furniture subtree (119 category nodes plus 8 brand-store nodes) - captured once from the DOM and processed locally. Cross-checked against the mega-menu, the footer and each category page's own child list. Also enumerated two furniture branches that are NOT children of furniture-10180: Home & Kitchen > Patio Lawn & Garden > Patio Furniture & Accessories (outdoor furniture, in scope) and Baby Products > Nursery > Furniture (nursery furniture, in scope). QTY: noon's rendered listing header ('N Results for ...') is exact only below about 100 and is otherwise bucketed ('800+', '3K+', '100K+'); on several nodes the page header is also inflated relative to the category itself (Telephone Tables page header '100+' vs 28 actual). The exact figure is published by noon's own catalog API, GET /_svc/catalog/api/v3/u/<category-path>/, which returns nbHits (exact), nbHitsText (the exact string the header renders) and breadcrumbs. Validated: on all six nodes where the rendered header was already exact (84, 24, 24, 24, 17, 84) nbHits equalled the header exactly, and on Telephone Tables nbHits=28 matched nbPages=1 with 28 hits returned - a full enumeration. Every qty here is that nbHits, with the API path and the rounded header string recorded in evidence. SANITY CHECKS: (1) bogus-slug test - .../sofas-and-couches/sectional-corner-sofas/zzz-not-real/ returns HTTP 200 serving the PARENT listing with the parent's title and count, so all 106 leaves were identity-checked against their own <title> and API breadcrumb; all 106 matched. (2) Counts vary per node, so no site-wide constant is being echoed. (3) Drift re-read of five nodes gave 733 vs 735 (Ladder Shelves) and 148 vs 149 (Table Benches), the other three identical - about 0.3% live-inventory drift. (4) straight-sofas, curved-sofas and round-sofas each report 24 and return an identical 24-SKU set, while corner-sofas (17) shares zero SKUs with them; the three are emitted and flagged as one listing served under three nav labels. SCOPE AND EXCLUSIONS: this is a giant general marketplace, so only furniture departments were enumerated. Excluded per brief: Mattresses (bedding), Furniture Parts & Accessories, Patio Furniture Covers, Patio Furniture Parts & Accessories, Umbrellas/Canopies/Gazebos/Shade, Kids Hampers, nursery Bassinet Bedding, nursery Organisers & Storage, nursery 'Furniture Collections', and every brand-store node (Home Box, Danube Home, vidaXL, SULSHA, INTEX, Generic, Sihoo, Songmics and about 20 more) since those are brand listing pages, not categories. The whole Home & Kitchen > Storage & Organisation department was inspected and excluded - it is organisers, hangers, space-saver bags, cabinet organisers and floating/corner wall shelves, i.e. the future Storage task rather than furniture. Home Decor was covered by the earlier Home-Decor pass and holds no furniture nodes. MARKETPLACE CAVEAT: several noon nodes carry counts far larger than the node name implies (Storage Trunks 80,720; Coat Racks 69,464; Bookcases 17,382; Hutch Furniture Attachments 17,372; Wine Racks 12,955; Hammocks 14,565). These are noon's own per-URL category totals, reported as such and flagged where most extreme, because marketplace sellers cross-list heavily into catch-all nodes. NAME COLLISION kept deliberately: 'TV & Media Furniture' appears both as a Living Room grouping node and as a separate 5-product leaf under Game & Recreation Room Furniture (different URL); the leaf is flagged.
